description: Complete native seven-table generator for Fay entities, spirits, beasts, and magical creatures from pages 228-232.

entries.title: Fay Entity, Spirit, and Magical Creature Generator
entries.summary: Roll or choose creature type, size, appearance, behavior, powers, weakness, and motivation to create a native Solanum Umbra supernatural entity.
body: The source presents this as a narrative generator for diverse Fay entities, beasts, spirits, and magical creatures. It does not provide combat statistics or convert results into another system.
Roll once on each table or choose results to match the story. Generated entities may later receive native combat records when the manuscript’s enemy and creature statistics are imported.
Minor typographical issues such as ‘Formles s’ and inconsistent Fay/Fae spelling are normalized for display while the source meaning remains unchanged.

tables.title: Entity Type
rows: Pure energy or light; barely visible and not fully corporeal
Bound to fire, water, earth, or air
Protector of sacred groves or ancient sites
Changes form and blends into the environment
Mischievous being that tests or deceives travelers
Malevolent Fay associated with death or decay
Mystical forest animal such as deer, bear, or wolf
Flying entity with wings of light or darkness
Part animal, part plant, and part elemental
Old and wise being tied to ancient land magic

tables.title: Entity Size
rows: Towers over trees as a moving force of nature

tables.title: Appearance Traits
rows: Covered in thorns or sharp protrusions
Eyes contain starlight, galaxies, or a night sky
Body partly covered in leaves, moss, or bark
Skin or fur changes color and blends with surroundings
Body contains crystal or gemstone structures
Legs, wings, or appendages resemble insects
More than two eyes in unusual patterns
Constant flame or heat surrounds the creature
Body appears liquid or constantly drips
Mystical mist or haze obscures its shape

tables.title: Behavior and Personality
rows: Defends a place or object fiercely
Mourns a loss or past event
Causes confusion or mischief without necessarily seeking harm
Seeks retribution against trespassers or old enemies
Communicates through riddles, silence, or elusive behavior
Guides or assists those in need

tables.title: Abilities and Powers
rows: Controls fire, water, earth, or air
Heals wounds or ailments by touch
Slows, accelerates, or temporarily stops time nearby
Steals life force to strengthen itself
Causes plants to grow, wither, or move
Bends natural law subtly or dramatically

tables.title: Weakness
rows: Specific symbols, rites, or objects ward or harm it
Knowledge of its true name grants power over it
Fire burns away or weakens its essence
Water contact or immersion drains its power
Specific rites or spells restrict its movement

tables.title: Alignment and Motivation
rows: Craves knowledge for altruistic or private purposes
Seeks to right an old wrong through revenge
Uses tests and tricks to teach or judge worth
Last protector of a forgotten place
Actively aids and protects worthy people
Watches and learns about the world

sourceRefs.notes: Seven complete generation tables for Fay entities, spirits, beasts, and magical creatures.
